what: A tool-free API worker's reply, cut short by an output-length limit, surfaced only as a bare "incomplete or unexpected" error with no way to tell why from the error alone.
rule: A failure to parse a worker's reply names the actual reason it failed, not just the fact that it did.
fix: Enforcement: the error now names the provider's own finish reason (e.g. truncated by length) directly. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-m3.test.mjs`.
